remarks: Enjoy serene living in the desirable Banksville area of Greenwich. This inviting home features a sun-filled kitchen that flows into a spacious family room with a gas fireplace and sliders leading to the backyard and pool. Upstairs, the primary bedroom includes an en-suite bath, accompanied by two additional bedrooms and another full bathroom. Outside, the level yard is bordered by mature landscaping-perfect for relaxing or entertaining. A deep two-car garage adds convenience with plenty of room for bicycles and extra storage.
